edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to equal owner() before MINTING_PAUSED can be toggled.
onlyOwner modifier gates the PURCHASE_LIMIT index write on msg.sender identity.
ownerSale is restricted by onlyOwner, so msg.sender controls entry.
msg.sender is hashed into keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)) for the gold list merkle proof and claim counters.
msg.sender feeds the silver list merkle proof verification and _allowListClaimed2 bookkeeping.
msg.sender feeds the patron list merkle proof, free-token condition and claim counters.
msg.sender becomes the mint recipient and claimedList entry in the public sale loop.
msg.sender is mixed into the randMod seed used to pick bounty winners.
withdraw is gated by the onlyowner modifier verifying a merkle proof over msg.sender.
block.timestamp is hashed into the pseudo-random output, making selection miner-influenceable.
randMod returns a value derived from block.timestamp and a low-entropy nonce, producing predictable randomness.
openBounty performs an external ETH transfer to selectedClaimer inside a loop before completing its bookkeeping.
The transfer to an arbitrary claimer hands control to the recipient, which could re-enter openBounty.
withdraw sends the entire balance via an external call to msg.sender without a reentrancy guard.
Control transfers to msg.sender during the payout, allowing re-entry into withdraw before state settles.
claimedList supplies the payout address selectedClaimer, linking attacker-influenced state to the external transfer.
bountyList marks paid addresses and terminates the openBounty while loop.
STAGE_PRICE elements are multiplied by numberOfTokens without SafeMath.
goldListSale computes STAGE_PRICE[0] * numberOfTokens in native arithmetic.
publicMint computes STAGE_PRICE[2] * numberOfTokens in native arithmetic.
publicMint adds totalSupply() and numberOfTokens with an unchecked native addition.
goldListSale adds totalSupply() and numberOfTokens without overflow protection.
silverListSale adds totalSupply() and numberOfTokens without overflow protection.
patronListSale adds totalSupply() and numberOfTokens without overflow protection.
ownerSale adds totalSupply() and numberOfTokens without overflow protection.
MINTING_PAUSED must be false for goldListSale to proceed.
MINTING_PAUSED must be false for publicMint to proceed.
CURRENT_STAGE must equal PUBLIC_SALE for publicMint to proceed.
setPauseMinting writes the MINTING_PAUSED state variable, altering the mint gate.
setStage writes CURRENT_STAGE, redirecting which sale path is active.
setOwnerMerkleRoot writes ownerMerkleRoot, which governs access to withdraw.
ownerMerkleRoot is the root checked by the onlyowner modifier guarding withdraw.
goldListMerkleRoot gates the isValidMerkleProof modifier on goldListSale.
silverListMerkleRoot gates the isValidMerkleProof modifier on silverListSale.
patronListMerkleRoot gates the isValidMerkleProof modifier on patronListSale.
ownerSale records each minted tokenId and msg.sender into claimedList.
goldListSale writes claimedList[tokenId] = msg.sender.
publicMint writes claimedList[tokenId] = msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: Mint quantity parameter only influences the public mint loop bounds and price check, so it is folded into the enclosing publicMint function.
The allow-list proof array is consumed solely by the isValidMerkleProof modifier of the sale entrypoint, so it is folded into goldListSale.
The pause boolean is a transient argument immediately written to MINTING_PAUSED, so it collapses into setPauseMinting.
The limit argument is stored directly into PURCHASE_LIMIT, so it collapses into setPurchaseLimit.
The merkle root argument is assigned to a single state variable setter, so it collapses into setGoldListMerkleRoot.
The stage index is only cast into the STAGE enum assigned to CURRENT_STAGE, so it collapses into setStage.
The URI argument is passed straight to _setBaseURI, so it collapses into setBaseURI.
The URI string is written directly to _contractURI, so it collapses into setContractURI.
The proof array is validated against ownerMerkleRoot only to authorize the balance payout, so it folds into withdraw.
The local balance snapshot is the amount of the external transfer, so it merges into the withdraw unsafe operation.
The local address is precisely the recipient of the bounty transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The local payout counter only controls the openBounty loop termination, so it folds into openBounty.
The local supply copy is only used as the modulus for randMod inside openBounty, so it folds into openBounty.
